The verifier's own three call sites (lines 2185-2188, 2511-2514, 2648-2651) were updated, so the literal requirement is met, and the pass/fail verdict is unaffected. A prior autofix round deferred it, with follow-up iss_93c7cf81f28af0ad.

  WHY: These values are strings from the fingerprints JSON, so a control character would split the `::warning::` line. This is consistency hardening, not a new defect (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1).
